tagline: Leading U.S. food retailer operating 2,244 stores across 35 states with 22 banners including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, and Jewel-Osco
hero_kpi_rationale: Digital Sales is the Hero KPI because it represents a fast-growing segment for the company, with a 21% increase during fiscal year 2025, reflecting the success of investments in digital platforms and customer experience.

kpis.name: Digital Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales realized through the company's digital channels, including Drive Up Go, home delivery, and online purchases.
kpis.description: Digital sales represent a growing segment for the company, with significant increases in investments in digital platforms.

kpis.name: Identical Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales realized in stores that have been open for at least one year, excluding fuel.
kpis.description: Identical sales represent a key indicator of the company's health and organic performance.

kpis.name: Loyalty Members
kpis.explanation: Number of members in the company's loyalty program, in millions.
kpis.description: The loyalty program represents a key tool for customer retention and engagement increase, with 51.2 million members in fiscal 2025.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the company, including product and service sales.
kpis.description: Net sales represent a key indicator of the company's health, reaching $83.2 billion in fiscal 2025.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin of the company, calculated as (revenue minus cost of sales) divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin represents a key indicator of the company's profitability, declining from 27.7% in fiscal 2024 to 27.2% in fiscal 2025.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the company before interest and taxes, in millions of dollars.
kpis.description: Operating income represents a key indicator of the company's health, declining from $1,546.1 million in fiscal 2024 to $727.6 million in fiscal 2025, impacted by opioid settlement-related charges.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income of the company after interest and taxes, in millions of dollars.
kpis.description: Net income represents a key indicator of the company's health, declining from $958.6 million in fiscal 2024 to $217.4 million in fiscal 2025, primarily impacted by a net charge of $600 million after taxes related to opioid settlement.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA of the company, excluding non-recurring items, in millions of dollars.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA represents a key indicator of the company's operational health, reaching $3,902 million in fiscal 2025, growing 10.3% compared to fiscal 2024.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures of the company, including store remodels and digital investments, in millions of dollars.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures represent a key indicator of the company's investment, totaling $1,833.6 million in fiscal 2025, including 94 remodels and 9 new store openings.
